text_simplified: This text discusses the virtue of reciting the Noble Qur'an and the importance of teaching it to children. It points out that those who teach their children the Qur'an and recite it will attain a great reward. It also mentions that children who recite the Qur'an will intercede for their parents on the Day of Judgment.

review_defects.english: those who teach their children the Qur'an and recite it
review_defects.why: The Arabic says the children recite it (يقرؤونه), but the English makes the subject 'those who teach' also the one who recites, changing who performs the recitation and thus the condition for the reward.
